text:
maya: Heads up — seeing several inference pods in ap-southeast-1 canary hang after NCCL 2.27.0 bump. Jobs stuck at collective stage (allgather/allreduce).
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: runtime v3.12 -> nccl 2.27.0 in ap-southeast-1.
ravi: Confirmed. 3 pods stuck, GPU processes present but utilization ~0%. Network TX pretty much 0. Logs show repeated 'NCCL WARN NET/CONNECT' then timeouts.
alex: Can we pause the rollout? @infra-oncall please. :eyes: 
infra-oncall: Pausing canary now, removing ap-southeast pools from rotation. Spawning tracing job to collect pstack/gdb + NCCLTRACE for stuck tasks. Will also flip autoscaler to ignore hung tasks for now.
julie: I attached a quick pstack/snippet from one of the stuck processes: 
```
Thread 1 (Thread 0x7f3b2c):
#0  0x7f3b6000 in __nccl_allreduce()
#1  0x7f3b7000 in ncclAllReduce
#2  0x7f3b8000 in runtime_collective_dispatch
#3  0x400f12 in main_loop
...
NCCL: NET/CONNECT timeout after 60000ms
```
sre-bot: Noted. Any change to CUDA driver or NIC firmware in that region recently?
maya: We rolled a CUDA driver micro-update (535.86) during last maintenance window in ap-southeast-1. Only APAC pools got the driver flip due to staggered rollout.
ravi: Network telemetry shows RDMA connect retries/deny spikes ~2s before hangs. NIC firmware on apac nodes is behind other regions (firmware v1.2.3 vs v1.3.0). Could be handshake mismatch with new nccl net layer.
alex: Proposed immediate steps: 1) collect full NCCLTRACE with env NCCL_DEBUG=WARN,NCCL_DEBUG_SUBSYS=NET 2) try rollback to nccl 2.26.3 on a small group 3) reproduce with NVLink disabled to isolate net vs p2p.
julie: I reproduced locally on a 4xA100 testserver: nccl 2.27.0 + driver 535.86 triggered collective timeouts after ~60s under our inference microbatch pattern. NVLink disable reduced frequency but didn't eliminate failure. Repro attached to ticket I opened.
maya: Impact: ~15% of canary capacity tied up, autoscaler couldn't replace because pods reported running. Cost hit small but risk to production if rollout continued. We should add a deadlock detector for collectives.
infra-oncall: Temporary mitigation: we adjusted liveness probe to detect stalled collectives (no tokens processed for >45s) and now kill/restart those pods. Patch deployed to canary pool.
ravi: Opening vendor ticket with logs, pstack, kernel module versions. Also uploaded kernel dmesg showing rdma errors and nv_peer_memory mismatches.
alex: Owners: julie -> reproducible test + pstack push to ticket; maya -> coordinate rollback decision if reproducer holds; infra -> keep liveness patch and rollback path ready; ravi -> vendor escalation. Marking P0 for visibility.
maya: Also adding heuristic to rollout: require network/firmware parity across region before NCCL bump. This should be a gating check.
sre-bot: Added incident channel and scheduled 30m postmortem tomorrow.
infra-oncall: Rolling rollback plan ready; holding until julie's repro confirm. :thumbsup:
